data.rationale: The proposal follows the same sequence (EDGAR ticker search, 10-K filter, Wikipedia infobox, email with the same subject and body), but it hardcodes the recipient as dana@example.com instead of using a {manager} parameter, it says "Send or discard" when the true workflow requires Discard and never Send, and it names the EDGAR full-text search page, which is vague and may be the wrong page. A builder could mostly automate it, but those gaps leave the recipient and the final step ambiguous.
